modules.responsibility: Define Inventory and Pricing Protocol abstractions that decouple service from implementations.
Provide RegularPricing and BulkPricing domain strategies implementing the Pricing protocol with strict validation and HALF_UP rounding.
Provide MemoryInventory infrastructure adapter implementing the Inventory protocol with hardcoded catalog data.
Orchestrate checkout quoting by validating inputs, delegating to injected Inventory and Pricing protocols without importing concrete classes.
Composition root that wires concrete implementations into CheckoutService and runs demonstration quotes.
Comprehensive unit and integration tests covering validation, collaborator mocking, boundary conditions, rounding, protocol conformance, and instance isolation.

patterns.name: Strategy
patterns.reason: RegularPricing and BulkPricing are interchangeable pricing algorithms behind the Pricing protocol, allowing new strategies without modifying CheckoutService.

patterns.name: Dependency Injection
patterns.reason: CheckoutService receives Inventory and Pricing via constructor injection, depending only on Protocol abstractions rather than concrete classes.

patterns.name: Adapter
patterns.reason: MemoryInventory adapts in-memory dictionary storage to the Inventory protocol interface expected by the service layer.

patterns.name: Repository
patterns.reason: MemoryInventory encapsulates data access for product pricing, isolating persistence concerns from business logic.
